note: Measured on the corpus this digest names, with no margin, per Owner ruling TCRN-CROSS-MIN-164 D4. Every floor here is the value scripts/retrieval-eval.mjs produced on this corpus at TCRN-CROSS-STORY-368; none was rounded, and none carries headroom. A number that moves in either direction is a fact about the scorer or the corpus, which is what this gate exists to surface.

incidentReplayIndependent.note: Historical 20-record development set. Its source-identity labels and thresholds are retained exactly; the old freeze claim is not evidence of a pre-registered holdout.

preRegisteredHoldout.note: Pre-registered Story identities disjoint from the historical Incident development set. Floors are fixed at 40%/60%/80% before the first holdout score; no model generated labels.
